features: DEDICATED GAME MODE WITH UP TO 50MS LOW LATENCY: Switch to Game Mode for low-latency wireless audio designed for responsive gaming. Use Music Mode when you want a more balanced audio experience for music, videos and everyday entertainment.
40MM GAMING-OPTIMIZED DRIVERS: Enjoy detailed game audio with 40mm drivers tuned for gaming, music and entertainment, helping you hear important details such as footsteps and in-game effects.

FLIP BOOM MICROPHONE: The flip-style boom microphone is positioned close to your mouth for gaming, calls and streaming, while the flexible design lets you move the microphone out of the way when not required.
BLUETOOTH 5.2 + AUX CONNECTIVITY: Connect wirelessly using Bluetooth 5.2 or switch to 3.5mm AUX wired audio when required. The included AUX cable provides added flexibility for compatible devices.
7 RGB GAMING LIGHT MODES: Customize your gaming setup with 7 lighting effects designed to complement your gaming environment.
UP TO 18 HOURS BATTERY BACKUP: Enjoy up to 18 hours of battery life under specified usage conditions. Battery performance can vary depending on RGB and usage settings.
OVER-EAR DESIGN WITH ADJUSTABLE HEADBAND: The adjustable headband and soft memory-protein ear pads are designed for a secure fit across gaming, music and everyday use.
